title: Sandbox: what it is and why almost every AI agent ships with it turned off
excerpt: I've spent weeks reading the documentation of the AI agents RosmarOps evaluates. Almost all of them have a sandbox. Almost none of them ship with it turned on.
seo_title: Sandbox in AI agents: who has one and who turns it on
seo_description: What a sandbox is, which AI agents ship with one and why almost all of them come with it turned off. What RosmarOps has started to show, with source and date.
